capture: Actual native PTY output rendered in real time; sidebar reflects observations from the same session.
privacy: The startup workspace address is masked through 5.1 seconds. Task text, selected models, responses and timing are preserved. Raw session, request and profile data remain private.

input.prompt: Start exactly one new background general-purpose agent; do not resume or fork a previous agent. Let Smart Router select its model. Ask it to read docs/claude-mod.md and report the cooldown duration and whether UG automatically retries the failed background task. Give it read-only instructions and prohibit child delegation. Wait for its result, then relay those two facts. Do not modify files, run tests, use network tools, retry a failed task, or start another agent. If routing or the task fails, report the actual failure and stop.
input.model_picker_source: Explicit options in an isolated copy of the UG-configured managed settings. All original policy, permission and hook fields are retained.

response_source: Live gateway using existing authentication; no model fixtures, response injection or manufactured failures.
acceptance: The explicit-picker live routing journey passed. Genuine rate-limit failure, cooldown exclusion and replacement selection remain unobserved.
full_catalog_limitation: The separate 31-option/29-service managed menu still exceeds the route API maximum of 20 distinct model services. This scenario does not repair that catalog/API mismatch or change deployed configuration.
interpretation: The child summarizes documented cooldown behavior; that answer does not execute or verify cooldown recovery.
